Explore the universe through NASA imagery, one remarkable view at a time.

DailyApod is an independent companion for NASA’s Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD). Discover daily space images and stories, browse the archive by date, and explore more NASA media in one focused, beautifully designed app.

DISCOVER MORE
• Today’s APOD with its full explanation
• Search APOD titles and descriptions
• Search NASA images, videos, and audio
• Hubble Birthday: see observations captured on your chosen date
• Earth Today: view imagery from NASA’s DSCOVR EPIC camera
• Curated popular, recent, and surprise discoveries

MAKE IT YOURS
• Save favorites and sync them with iCloud
• Share inspiring images and stories
• Add daily and random astronomy widgets to your Home Screen
• Enjoy a polished experience in light and dark themes
• Translate APOD explanations in the app

ABOUT DATES
APOD follows NASA’s publication schedule in the America/New_York time zone, so the date shown in the app may differ from your local date by one day.

DailyApod is an independent app and is not endorsed by or affiliated with NASA. Images and information are provided by NASA and their respective credited sources.

Create personal icons for files and folders with Moodsk, a focused desktop icon editor.

Build icons from:
• Your own images
• System symbols and emoji
• Editable text and monograms
• Curated icon packs

Edit with precision:
• Drag, resize and rotate unlocked layers
• Click text directly to rewrite it
• Change colour, scale, blend effects and styles
• Reorder layers and preview every change
• Sync edits across every icon in a pack

Work the way you want:
• Drag in a file or folder to replace its icon
• Apply one design to multiple items in a batch
• Create a new folder with its icon already set
• Restore the original icon with the included right-click extension

Exporting and applying icons requires Editor Pro, a one-time in-app purchase. The Placard and Picnic icon packs are separate in-app purchases.

Moodsk keeps desktop organisation quick, visual and reversible. Your selected files stay on your computer and are never uploaded.

Erase unwanted objects from your photos with TUTU. Mark an object with a brush, freehand shape, or tap-to-select, then let AI fill the selected area.

• Open a photo from your library or drag in an image.
• Mark the area to remove with a brush, shape, or tap-to-select.
• Zoom, undo, and redo to refine your edit.
• Save the result to Photos.

Image editing runs on your device. No account is required. Try editing for free. TUTU Premium is required to save edited photos to your photo library.

TUTU Premium
• Monthly subscription: save edited photos to Photos while your monthly subscription is active.
• Annual subscription: the same photo-saving feature while your annual subscription is active.
• Lifetime purchase: permanently unlock the same photo-saving feature with one payment.

The purchase screen shows the current price, billing period, and any eligible free trial before purchase. Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your Apple Account is charged for each renewal. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Record privately. Understand the sounds of your night. Discover memorable moments.

YOUR BEDTIME ROOM
Start your night in a cozy bedroom. Arrange furniture and change the room to make it your own. Optional furniture purchases are available.

Go Sleep listens while you rest and uses on-device sound analysis to organize likely snoring, speech-like events that may be sleep talking, and cough-like sounds. Silence is never intentionally stored, and detected events become short playable clips.

NIGHT SOUNDS AT A GLANCE
• Review Snoring, Possible Sleep Talking, and Cough-like Sounds separately
• See when each sound type appeared in simple night narrative cards
• Explore a clock-aligned event timeline and relative loudness
• Compare patterns across nights and reported sleep positions

SNORING INSIGHTS
• Follow your 0–100 Snore Load wellness trend
• Review detected duration, episodes, and longest events
• Track weekly and monthly patterns without turning every sound into one sleep score

DISCOVER THE FUN SIDE OF SLEEP
Hear memorable Sound Matches shared by the community. When you want to join in, you choose exactly which clip to publish. Your private night report stays unchanged.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY
• Audio analysis happens on your iPhone
• No speech transcription is performed
• Silence is never intentionally stored
• Recordings stay on your device unless you enable private iCloud Sync
• Public sharing is always an explicit choice

WIDGETS AND LONG-TERM INSIGHTS
Start a recording quickly and follow night sound activity from your Home Screen. Go Sleep Pro unlocks deeper insights, full report history, and longer clip retention. Private iCloud Sync is free for all users.

Possible Sleep Talking and Cough-like Sounds are audio observations. They do not confirm who spoke and are not symptom counts or medical assessments.

Go Sleep provides wellness trends and is not a medical device or diagnosis. If you are concerned about sleep apnea or breathing interruptions, speak with a healthcare professional.
